Minimalistischer Elgato Stream Deck Ständer

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2270773-minimalist-elgato-stream-deck-stand#profileId-2475245

Please make sure the Steam Deck sits on the same face that was on the build plate. The face with the texture. Orientation for print is Face Down.

 

Looking for a clean, no-nonsense way to elevate your Elgato Stream Deck? Or tired of the flimsy OEM stand that comes with it? This minimalist Stream Deck stand is designed with simplicity and style in mind. No hinges, no moving parts. Just a solid, static angle that keeps your Stream Deck perfectly positioned while maintaining a sleek desk aesthetic.

 

Why you’ll love it:

* Minimal & modern design - blends seamlessly with any setup
* Static angle - optimized for everyday streaming, editing, and productivity
* Rock-solid stability - no wobble, no adjustments, no distractions
* Easy to print - beginner friendly and fast to produce
* Compact footprint - keeps your desk clean and uncluttered
Whether you’re a streamer, content creator, or productivity power user, this stand keeps the focus on what matters, your workflow. If you appreciate clean lines, functional design, and a clutter-free desk, this one’s for you. 🚀

 

Happy printing! 🖨️💡

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF)
